title: Donald Sadoway: The missing link to renewable energy
summary: MIT professor Donald Sadoway argues that grid-scale storage is the missing piece for renewable energy. He sketches at the blackboard how large, cheap liquid-metal batteries could store wind and solar power.
why: Referenced as an early, inspiring presentation of the molten-metal battery idea that later grid-storage startups pursued.

quote.text: He made a lot of media around this technology 10 years ago. See the TedTalk
